items.name: Morvah's Shawl
items.lore: Folded neatly, as if for a stranger. It smells of salt and summer evenings.

items.name: Drowned-Net Belt
items.lore: Knotted from a net that has been mended every evening for a thousand years.

items.name: Salt-Pearl Ring
items.lore: A pearl from the drowned land. It is always wet.

items.name: Evening Star Pendant
items.lore: Silver, set with a pale stone that glows at dusk.

items.name: Reliquary Shard
items.lore: A shard of black glass from an Arawnite reliquary. Something moves inside it.

items.name: Kendric's Watch-Cloak
items.lore: A knight's travelling cloak, salt-stained from the Lyonesse wind.

items.name: Drowned Knight Signet
items.lore: The ring of a knight of Lyonesse. He drowned with his king.

items.name: Hierophant's Girdle
items.lore: Bone and black silk, taken from a priest of Arawn. Scrubbed, and blessed, and still not quite clean.
